description: Export contract for the Idea Hub web builder. Everything in framework/ is copied into a new project on idea creation. The launcher reads this file — not the filesystem — to learn what to export, which agents read which files, and where the UI writes back. Key-by-key schema: MANIFEST.md.

design.label: Design
design.downstream: design tokens, component specs, and state docs are stage OUTPUTS and live in the project's own design-system workspace, not in the export unit

review.label: Review
review.note: Pipeline position 4. Own stage, not a QA role: its inputs span BA, Design, Build, and QA. Owns no skill bodies — audits via shared rules.

shared.rule: a skill body lives here only when two or more stages consume it; consumers keep a thin binding file in their own skills/ folder

outside_export_root.note: Lives outside framework/ but is copied into the project at export time (existing files are never overwritten) — same copy lifecycle as root_files, different source location.
